```{r, message=FALSE}
library(CASSIA)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
```

When fitting the model to a new site you need to understand how sensitive the
outputs are to each parameter. The function below runs the model repeatedly
over a range of values for one parameter at a time.

## Setup weather data

```{r}
weather_original$dates <- as.Date(
  strptime(paste(rep(2015:2017, times = c(365, 366, 365)), weather_original$X),
           format = "%Y %j"))
```

## Sensitivity analysis function

```{r}
run_sensitivity <- function(param_name, range, weather) {
  map(range, function(i) {
    parameters_p_new <- parameters_p
    if (param_name %in% rownames(parameters_p_new)) {
      parameters_p_new["Hyde"][rownames(parameters_p_new) == param_name, ] <- i
      result <- CASSIA_cpp(weather, site = "Hyde",
                           parameters = parameters_p_new)
      list(param_value = i, result = result)
    } else {
      message("Parameter '", param_name,
              "' not found. Check spelling — underscore vs dot matters.")
      NULL
    }
  })
}
```

Run it for a few parameters:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sensitivity_sDc      <- run_sensitivity("sDc",           seq(0, 10, length.out = 10), weather_original)
sensitivity_sD0_Trad <- run_sensitivity("sD0.Trad",      seq(-7, 0,  length.out = 10), weather_original)
sensitivity_dgs      <- run_sensitivity("diameter_start_day", seq(50, 200, length.out = 10), weather_original)
```

## Plotting the results

Extract a single output column across all runs to compare:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
extract_yearly <- function(sensitivity_list, param_name, output_col) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sensitivity_list, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    yearly <- x$result$Growth
    data.frame(
      param_name  = param_name,
      param_value = x$param_value,
      year        = unique(as.numeric(format(as.Date(yearly$date), "%Y"))),
      value       = tapply(yearly[[output_col]],
                           as.numeric(format(as.Date(yearly$date), "%Y")), sum)
    )
  }))
}

plot_data <- bind_rows(
  extract_yearly(sensitivity_sDc,      "sDc",                "wall.tot.growth"),
  extract_yearly(sensitivity_sD0_Trad, "sD0.Trad",           "wall.tot.growth"),
  extract_yearly(sensitivity_dgs,      "diameter_start_day", "wall.tot.growth")
)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = param_value, y = value, colour = factor(year))) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~param_name, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Total wall growth (kg C)", colour = "Year")
```
